name: TASK-549.24 canonical module ownership
summary: Integrate the seven reviewed implementation fragments into one canonical architecture, with recursive module ownership and retained original history.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#HggZR41l
changes.value: Connects canonical pane and feature owners

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#HggZR41l
changes.value: Mounts canonical readers and captured recordings. It never opens a live legacy board. Existing legacy addresses resolve through retained originals after migration. Unmigrated vaults expose explicit migration guidance. The shared pane session reports captured canonical readings to local agents.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#r6IpmadI
changes.value: Legacy live content and authoring routes retire. Migration and exact retained-original readers remain under canonical operations.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#wYcdVszt
changes.value: Provides canonical model initialization, reads, edits, proposals, subject claims, migration, history, and recovery.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#wYcdVszt
changes.value: Canonical initialization, reads, edits, proposals, claims, history, and recovery own live architecture. Legacy decoding remains only for migration and exact retained originals.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#Y70KOm9C
changes.value: Routes canonical model read, initialization, edit, migration, archive, render, code, repository, and pane operations through their owners.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#Y70KOm9C
changes.value: The application mounts canonical architecture routes alongside code, repository, service, and pane routes. Legacy semantic-board content, writer, claim, rename, discard, and move routes are no longer mounted.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#zWQG6LJZ
changes.value: Lists repository architecture and migration availability

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#zWQG6LJZ
changes.value: Reads repository identities and canonical model authority through the shared query cache. The navigator opens each model in the active pane. Legacy authority exposes migration guidance instead of fetching live board listings or levels.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#MUs4pwRq
changes.value: Hosts the local server and routes explicitly addressed canonical model, migration, rendering, code, repository, and pane operations.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#MUs4pwRq
changes.value: The server owns the shared local HTTP and socket process. Canonical model and migration routes refuse legacy live authority; pane and workbench routes remain separate owners.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#c4LPnwh5
changes.value: Connects repository navigation, local agents, and canonical panes

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#c4LPnwh5
changes.value: The desktop frame keeps the repository navigator, local agent controls, conversation, and canonical panes. Repository actions open current modules through the shared router. Unmigrated repositories show their migration state. Board ownership and level controls are retired.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#3LoKNA2g
changes.value: Every local-agent context reads canonical model state and the pane’s exact capture. Legacy authority returns migration guidance without supplying legacy board content. Explanations use the registered tab workhorse; latest-action discovery starts no work.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/vKEsyHFk#8XKRkSHl
changes.value: Architecture inputs

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/vKEsyHFk#8XKRkSHl
changes.value: Stores canonical modules, relationships, flows, proposals, and walkthroughs

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/vKEsyHFk#8XKRkSHl
changes.value: Modules own their outgoing relationships. Independent flow collections describe exchanges. Compact proposals and authored narratives refer to stable subjects, while exact history lives in the signed archive.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#UNYvWHmE
changes.value: Publishes complete canonical subject-claim and durable action snapshots with explicit vault identity to panes.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#UNYvWHmE
changes.value: Consumes the public model feed and sends complete vault snapshots through the existing pane broadcast. Multiple subject claims may coexist. Only a durable operation receipt supplies writer and doing attribution. After the last claim ends, a durable action lingers briefly and then the tracker sends an empty snapshot.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#yQCdykGt
changes.value: Runs canonical model and policy checks, with code and embed checks owned by their existing operations.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#yQCdykGt
changes.value: In a Git checkout with no vault, check, check all and check embeds run embeds alone and report why semantics/code were skipped. With a vault, check semantics reads canonical model diagnostics and authored policy; legacy authority returns migration guidance without changing source. Code and embed checks keep their existing owners.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#mStVd7fZ
changes.value: Streams durable canonical model changes by addressed vault into agent context with revision cursors and receipt attribution.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#mStVd7fZ
changes.value: Follows watchArchitectureModel once per vault and emits only completed architecture_changed events. External file changes have no writer or doing attribution. The cursor belongs to the process feed and starts again after restart.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#vn4RDLH9
changes.value: Lists pane captures and shows an explicit canonical model reading in one pane, reporting any repository checkout choice.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#vn4RDLH9
changes.value: browser show resolves exact model, module, state, flow, and walkthrough selectors before moving the pane. A successful request may select the model repository checkout; its receipt reports that choice. browser panes reports vault, repository, checkout, tab, and exact reading capture.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#R3ldC44x
changes.value: Decodes legacy board bytes in memory for explicit migration and exact retained-original readings.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#R3ldC44x
changes.value: The decoder is used by legacy inventory and retained-original readers. It keeps source text for comparison and recovery and does not persist ordinary schema upgrades.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#YXy1uQYC
changes.value: Carries canonical model change events into agent context and vault-keyed activity snapshots onto the pane broadcast.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#YXy1uQYC
changes.value: The model change feed carries durable operation events into agent context. The activity tracker broadcasts complete vault-keyed subject claims and durable action metadata. Legacy board-content announcements are retired.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/gbyqW4H3#JK2EHDyY
changes.value: Draws projected canonical architecture and flow content in any host through the shared layout and SVG core.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/gbyqW4H3#JK2EHDyY
changes.value: Canonical readers project models and flows through @archboard/board/content before drawing. The renderer receives content, grammar, policy and host inputs; it does not resolve model identity or navigation.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#tHLqdtCJ
changes.value: Publishes canonical reading context and exact-capture requirements; legacy-authority refusals return explicit migration guidance.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/Oi6SBIAM#tHLqdtCJ
changes.value: Publishes canonical model context and exact captured reading selectors to local agents. Unmigrated vaults expose migration guidance instead of board authoring or fixed levels.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#mYtOhgML
changes.value: Lists known canonical models whose current or active proposed modules bind a repository.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#mYtOhgML
changes.value: Scans chosen checkouts and registered untracked vaults, then reads canonical model and proposal modules. LEGACY_AUTHORITY produces no match; discovery does not decode or rewrite legacy board files.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#nn1ec9Tw
changes.value: Adapts canonical discovery, initialization, exact readings, archive history, and the existing change feed. Unmigrated vaults receive explicit migration guidance.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#tbH9ZyCA
changes.value: Keeps pane sockets and tab sessions live; existing publishers send canonical change and activity snapshots.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#tbH9ZyCA
changes.value: Pane routes and sockets retain presentation state. The canonical change feed carries model events to agent context, while the activity tracker broadcasts vault-keyed subject claims and durable action attribution.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/gbyqW4H3#bm9AWXkW
changes.value: Carries canonical model selectors and the exact input revision in the existing SVG metadata recipe. The embed checker reuses canonical reading and rendering owners.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#tTkbidT4
changes.value: The existing installer initializes new vaults through the shared canonical initializer. Existing vaults receive an explicit migration route without automatic rewriting.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#cNaEpWjJ
changes.value: Reads one live canonical model or an exact retained reading. The shared decoder orders collections and walkthroughs consistently. Legacy bytes serve explicit migration and original history only.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#gRG7JEPt
changes.value: Renders a canonical structural reading or a complete explicitly selected flow as architecture, sequence, or flowchart.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/HBlhIeSD#gRG7JEPt
changes.value: Renders architecture, sequence, and flowchart from canonical readings through the shared client-local projection and existing Bun renderer.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/6E6hL0Zk#C9EOzoYB
changes.value: Publishes canonical model and captured reading context to the existing local agents. Unmigrated vault context exposes migration instructions without legacy live content.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#Bd4GPG6d
changes.value: Retains exact architecture and source associations, then reopens those bytes independently of current files. Public metadata omits private reference and narrative dependency records.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#ZRq51Ecz
changes.value: Stores signed architecture checkpoints with actual dependency parents. Exact object I/O batches blob writes and builds trees without changing source branches or the index.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#108U3Rhl
changes.value: read inputs and build trees

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#108U3Rhl
changes.value: Uses checkpointBlobs for retained reads and tree for exact batched writes.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#DQ99hH5l
changes.value: Archive object I/O

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#DQ99hH5l
changes.value: Reads exact retained objects and builds architecture trees

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#DQ99hH5l
changes.value: Batched Git object writes avoid one process per authored file. NUL-delimited tree entries preserve exact paths. The existing process owner controls cancellation and deadlines.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#EekL5c17
changes.value: Decodes legacy board documents only for explicit migration inventory and exact retained-original readings.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#EekL5c17
changes.value: Retains the legacy decoder for explicit migration and exact originals. Legacy public authoring, ownership, moves, and automatic schema persistence retire.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#7mTerd6Y
changes.value: Installs an explicitly approved mapping through the existing signed archive, journal, and recovery owner. Canonical decoding normalizes proposal baselines before fingerprinting. Original bytes, addresses, and independent drafts remain available.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#66xX05dW
changes.value: Canonical models are the one live authoring format. Model commands own discovery, recursive readings, proposals, history, code inspection, and walkthroughs. Legacy commands retire.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#KJy5yYuq
changes.value: Stores compact changes against exact retained predecessors. Consistent decoding keeps predecessor fingerprints stable across live and retained inputs. Changed predecessors require explicit reconciliation or replacement decisions.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#CLdaoYy3
changes.value: Installs canonical initialization, portable imports, and explicit migration through one signed archive, journal, atomic writer, and recovery mechanism.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#IgYndyJd
changes.value: Projects canonical readings through the shared content interface

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/yejBBUFY#IgYndyJd
changes.value: Consumes the shared projectModel, modelContent, and projectFlow implementation exposed by @archboard/board/content. Browser and structural export share one projection with exact scope, focus, visibility, and behavioral flow semantics.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#yNZEhzyc
changes.value: Applies flow and message changes within one complete model edit. Explicitly removed messages do not block endpoint removal. Surviving edited or moved messages still require valid endpoints.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#255ksC3D
changes.value: Exports scoped canonical architecture or a complete explicitly selected flow as SVG with an exact reading receipt.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/XppR9owz#255ksC3D
changes.value: Exports structural and behavioral canonical readings through the shared projection and existing renderer. The existing render recipe records exact selectors and revision for reproducible embeds.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#Mv3r4IsX
changes.value: Resolves explicit repository, model, subject, and state references. Same-model reads use the captured candidate without reopening its public write barrier. Foreign reads retain their normal ownership checks.

changes.subject: vKEsyHFk/0T9enjhi#QDE2xctM
changes.value: Retains exact reference dependencies through Git ancestry. A proposal reference to current uses the captured current checkpoint. A checkpoint does not embed its own future identity.
